page.overview:
Who is Julie Sands?

Julie Sands is a fictional character created by Dan Wickline in 2012, first appearing in issue #1 of the 1st volume of Grimm Fairy Tales Presents: Call of Wonderland by Zenescope Entertainment.

Julie Sands is a studious young woman in college who spent much of her time alone in a library until she happened across a journal written by H. P. Lovecraft. Unfortunately for Julie, she was unaware of the dark secrets in her past. She and her friend Salome Gray were dragged into the madness of Wonderland. They vanquished their foes and returned to Earth, but were soon drawn back into Wonderland by the power of the Queen of Spades, who needed them to fill the role of the Queen of Hearts in Wonderland.
